briefdescription.para: Runs unit-discovery, parse, and index jobs on a thread pool, and applies results to the index.

detaileddescription.para: Registers built-in languages and loads dynamic language libraries into index. When a toolchain tree arrives, UnitsJob discovers compilation units and emits the files tree. Each file row whose family has a language receives a ParseJob, which reads or parses the file (or open buffer) and may also produce a SymbolDocument. Each unit row whose dependencies have no pending ParseJob and whose language supports indexing receives an IndexJob that builds a SymbolDocument. Jobs hold inputs by value, run on the pool, and signal the message thread to apply results in handleAsyncUpdate().

The processor also dispatches request rows via events to Query and manages in-memory editor buffers. Unready requests wait until Id::isIndexed turns true while moveRequestJobsToFront() prioritizes their prerequisite jobs.
